thread:
Maya Chen: hi all, first week here! I'm trying to run a quick eval in the eu-west1 GCP project but getting permission denied when listing instances. not sure who to ping for billing/region perms :wave:

Maya Chen: here's the output i get:```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.list) PERMISSION_DENIED: Request had insufficient authentication scopes.
You do not have permission to access project: redwood-eu-test
```

Maya Chen: also when i open the AWS console my account can't see the billing account for the team (shows AccessDenied). i think my SSO group might be missing something. :grimacing:

alex_devops: welcome Maya! :tada: quick q — did you get added to the infra SSO group or just basic engineering?

Maya Chen: only "engineering:default" AFAIK. i filled the new-hire form yesterday.

alex_devops: ok that explains it. For GCP eu projects we require membership in infra-eu (or infra-admins for broader access). For access you'll need at minimum: `roles/browser` on the project and `roles/compute.viewer` for listing instances. For billing you need `billing.user` on the billing account or be in the Billing Viewers group.

alex_devops: if you want to try a quick check run:```
gcloud auth list
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-test --format=json
```

pam_it: looping in IT. @Maya Chen i've started a request to add you to `infra-eu` and billing viewers. Ticket INC-1029 created. infra-bot logged it.

infra-bot: Ticket INC-1029 created by pam_it for user Maya Chen — "New hire EU region + billing access". Priority: P2. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1029

Maya Chen: thanks Pam! do you need my org id or project id?

pam_it: i've got your employee id from the new-hire form. i'll add you to the SSO group, should propagate within 10-15 min. i'll also request billing link to the redwood-eu-billing account.

javier_cloudops: FYI EU billing is on a separate org folder. if the billing account isn't linked to the project you'll see AccessDenied on AWS console too sometimes (confusing). i'll watch the ticket and attach the billing link once SSO is done.

Maya Chen: trying `gcloud compute instances list --project=redwood-eu-test` again now...

Maya Chen: still permission denied, but SSO propagated 5m ago.

alex_devops: sometimes the directory group sync lags. can you paste output of `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-test --filter=bindings.members:maya.chen@redwood.com --format=json` (just copy/paste)?

Maya Chen: pasting:```
[]
```

alex_devops: yeah not added yet. i'll grant temporary `roles/compute.viewer` on the project while IT fixes the group so you can get unblocked. give me a minute.

alex_devops: done — you should have `compute.viewer` now. try again.

Maya Chen: omg that worked, i can list instances and SSH into the test vm. thank you!!! :relieved:

Maya Chen: AWS billing page still shows AccessDenied but i can proceed with GCP work for now.

pam_it: we've added you to infra-eu SSO group and requested billing viewers role on the AWS billing account. should be in place within the hour.

javier_cloudops: i've linked redwood-eu-test to the org billing account. you should have billing access after the IAM change.

Maya Chen: confirmed — AWS billing page is now visible. everything working. really appreciate the quick help everyone. :sparkles:

alex_devops: welcome aboard again! ping #eng if anything else pops up during ramp.

pam_it: closing INC-1029 once propagation finishes. leaving notes for onboarding doc (add step: confirm infra SSO group membership + billing link).

Maya Chen: adding to my onboarding checklist. thanks :raised_hands:"
